item.title: Largest Squid Ever Filmed Captured Near Japan's Ogasawara Islands in 2006
item.description:
Largest Squid Ever Filmed Captured Near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands in 2006

This is the story of the largest squid ever filmed, in December 2006 near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands.

📸 The Event

  • First time the largest squid was ever filmed
  • Occurred in December 2006
  • Location: near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands

🌊 Significance

  • Represents the largest squid ever successfully filmed
  • Adds rare documentation to marine biology records

#MarineBiology #WildlifeFilming #OgasawaraIslands #Squid

Source: Friday Squid Blogging: The Largest Squid Ever Filmed - Schneier on Security
